Purpose:   To establish a uniform procedure to be used by all
applicants when requesting a reconsideration to install a Class
"E" type Fire Alaram System in any building or any space of a
building with an occupancy other than Group "E".




Any request for the instal ation of a Clas "E" Type Fire Alaram System in any buildings or any space of a building with an oc upancy other than Group "E" shal be ad res ed to the Deputy Com is ioner, Technical Af airs, and shal include the fol owinging information:

                                                                                                                 Complete description of the building (i.e., construction
                                                                                                                 classification, height, number of floors, number of
                                                                                                                 exits, fire ratings of corridors, shafts, stair
                                                                                                                 enclosures, etc.).

                                                             2. Complete working operation description or narrative of

    3. The occupancy and the use of each floor.

       which have been installed or are proposed to be
       installed (i.e., sprinkler system, standpipe system,
       etc.)

    5. Comparison between the Class "E" Fire Alaram System and
       the Fire Alarm required by the Building Code, "if any",
       in terms of operation and equipment, showing ho
                   w Class "E" will exceed the requirements of the system required

    6. A narrative to indicate the method of compliance with
